name: checkbox-44
description: Playlist download picker that totals the storage size of checked tracks.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { Download as DownloadIcon, } from "@designali/icons" import { Button } from "@workspace/ui/components/button" import { Checkbox } from "@workspace/ui/components/checkbox" const tracks = [ { title: "Colorful Spheres", artist: "Designali Motion", mb: 8.4 }, { title: "Abstract Fluid", artist: "Designali Motion", mb: 9.1 }, { title: "Studio Reel", artist: "Designali CGI", mb: 11.6 }, { title: "Icon Animations", artist: "Designali Icons", mb: 7.2 }, ] export default function OfflineDownloadTracks() { const [picked, setPicked] = React.useState( tracks.map((t) => t.title) ) const size = tracks .filter((t) => picked.includes(t.title)) .reduce((s, t) => s + t.mb, 0) return (
{tracks.map((track, index) => ( ))}
{size.toFixed(1)} MB on device
) }
